_source: GHMC nala (storm-water drain) network with encroachment counts
_licence: OpenCity (Other/Public Domain); attribute GHMC/HMDA (data) and OpenCity (digitisation)
_vintage_unknown: The KML carries no edition or survey date. Treat as an undated GHMC extract; do not present it as current-year.
_note: GHMC nala (storm-water drain) network with per-nala length and segment count. The layer also DEFINES an encroachment schema (Govt_Encr / Pvt_Encr / Rel_Encr / Total_Encr / Court_Case) which GHMC ships EMPTY - see _empty_columns. Those fields are stripped rather than published, because rendering them would read as 'zero encroachments' in the city that created HYDRAA to demolish them.

_empty_columns.meaning: Published by GHMC but uniformly zero across all 96 nalas - unpopulated, NOT a measurement of zero. Do not render as data. Surface as a named gap, and as an RTI ask whose exact shape GHMC has already specified.
